conclusion.rationale: Dynamic testing blocked by missing build dependencies (libapr1-dev, libaprutil1-dev). Static analysis with 0.95 confidence confirms OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGE: removal of dump_content(ctx) from pcomment restores correct HTML output order and eliminates content duplication. The change fixes a regression (r1934975, Github #681) where accumulated CDATA/text content was incorrectly flushed before comments. Since no dynamic testing could be performed, backward compatibility cannot be confirmed through execution evidence, though the static analysis strongly indicates this is a correct bug fix restoring intended behavior.
recommended_actions: Install libapr1-dev and libaprutil1-dev on a build host

Verify no content duplication in proxy HTML output with test page containing comments and CDATA
Run existing httpd test suite to confirm no regressions
